This page lists 82 Figma keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `figma.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Figma to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t figma.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/figma.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Figma.app`; if Figma lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## File

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇧⌘N` | New window |
| `⌘N` | New file |
| `⌘O` | Open file browser |
| `⇧⌘W` | Close window |
| `⌘W` | Close tab |
| `⇧⌘E` | Export |
| `⇧⌘S` | Save as .fig file |
| `⌥⌘S` | Save to version history |
| `⇧⌘K` | Place |

## Edit

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘Z` | Undo |
| `⇧⌘Z` | Redo |
| `⌘X` | Cut |
| `⌘C` | Copy |
| `⌘V` | Paste |
| `⇧⌘V` | Paste over selection |
| `⌘D` | Duplicate |
| `⌫` | Delete |
| `⌥⌘C` | Copy properties |
| `⌥⌘V` | Paste properties |
| `⌘A` | Select all |
| `⇧⌘A` | Select inverse |
| `⌃⌘Space` | Emoji & symbols |

## View

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `+` | Zoom in |
| `-` | Zoom out |
| `!` | Zoom to fit |
| `@` | Zoom to selection |
| `)` | Zoom to 100% |
| `⌘R` | Rename layer |
| `⇧R` | Rulers |
| `⌃P` | Pixel preview |
| `⌃G` | Layout grids |
| `⌘Y` | Outlines |

## Tools

Press key to activate tool.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `V` | Move tool |
| `P` | Pen tool |
| `R` | Rectangle tool |
| `O` | Ellipse tool |
| `L` | Line tool |
| `F` | Frame tool |
| `S` | Slice tool |
| `⌃C` | Pick color |

## Object

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘G` | Group selection |
| `⌥⌘G` | Frame selection |
| `⌘⇧G` | Ungroup selection |
| `⌥⌘K` | Create component |
| `⌥⌘B` | Detach instance |
| `⌃⌘M` | Toggle mask |
| `⌥⌘]` | Bring to front |
| `⌘]` | Bring forward |
| `⌘[` | Send backward |
| `⌥⌘[` | Send to back |
| `⇧H` | Flip horizontal |
| `⇧V` | Flip vertical |
| `⌘E` | Flatten selection |
| `⌘⇧O` | Outline stroke |
| `⌘⇧H` | Show/hide selection |
| `⌘⇧L` | Lock/unlock selection |
| `⌥L` | Collapse layers |

## Vector

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘J` | Join selection |
| `⇧⌘J` | Smooth join selection |
| `⇧⌫` | Delete & heal selection |

## Text

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘B` | Bold |
| `⌘I` | Italic |
| `⌘U` | Underline |
| `⌘<` | Increase font size |
| `⌘>` | Decrease font size |
| `⌥,` | Increase line height |
| `⌥.` | Decrease line height |
| `⌥<` | Increase letter space |
| `⌥>` | Decrease letter space |
| `⌥⌘L` | Text align left |
| `⌥⌘R` | Text align right |
| `⌥⌘T` | Text align center |
| `⌥⌘J` | Text align justified |

## Arrange

Alignment shortcuts.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌥A` | Align left |
| `⌥H` | Align h. centers |
| `⌥D` | Align right |
| `⌥W` | Align top |
| `⌥V` | Align v. centers |
| `⌥S` | Align bottom |
| `⌃⌥T` | Tidy up |
| `⌃⌥H` | Distribute h. spacing |
| `⌃⌥V` | Distribute v. spacing |

## Template file

The full [`figma.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/figma.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
